headline: Global Diversification Becomes Danantara's Shield to Cushion IHSG Correction
summary: BPI Danantara has reportedly eased pressure on Indonesia's stock market in 2026 through global investment diversification, amid a correction in the IHSG index.
why: Danantara is Indonesia's sovereign wealth fund, and its portfolio decisions can influence domestic equity flows and investor sentiment.
original_headline: Diversifikasi Global Jadi Tameng Dananatara Redam Koreksi IHSG
